title: 第一卷 第2章 寿元商城
slug: 木屋求生一天一个神级特性
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

脑中想想又不犯法！

手中石斧没有停歇，又朝着第二棵大树砍了过去。

砍树过程中，秦龙大概看了一下手环和手册。

这手环看起来就像是直接镶嵌在自己手臂上一样。

没有任何感觉，浑然天成。

意念一动，上面就弹出了一个蓝色的页面。

区域聊天界面、全民聊天界面（黑色）、交易界面、好友界面（黑色）、商城！

很快秦龙就大概搞清楚了这个手环的功能。

原来蓝星的人类，全都被干到这里了。

手环能够让人类互相之间聊天交易之类的。

全民聊天现在是黑色的，还没有启动！

全人类被应该被划分了很多的区域。

区域人数显示10000！

应该是一个区域一万人！

交易界面里面，大家都可以互相交易。

交易彼此需要的东西！

而这个商城，点开一看，目前只有一些简单的吃喝和工具！

但这货币，当真有点耐人寻味！

想要购买这个商城里面的东西，要用自己的寿元去购买！

一桶五斤的纯净水，需要一年的寿元！

一把铁制的斧头或者别的工具之类，需要十年的寿元！

这尼玛的有点过分了。

用自己的寿元来换取这些东西。

这简直难以想象。

五斤的水就需要一年的寿元。

如果在外面找不到水，又没有能够交易的东西。

那岂不是说要用自己的寿元喝水了。

正常人类一共才有多少寿元？

按照这个商城里面兑换的东西来说。

一般的中年人，只要换上几把工具，就基本上就直接噶了！

而且你还看不到自己到底有多少寿元！

因为商城里面，有一个寿元显示器，需要十年的寿元才能够换到。

有了寿元显示器，才能够看到自己还剩下多少寿元。

这纯属有点赌了！

content_en:
Page (1/3)

It’s not illegal to think about it in your head!

The stone ax in his hand didn't stop, and he chopped at the second big tree.

During the process of cutting down the tree, Qin Long briefly looked at the bracelet and manual.

This bracelet looks like it is directly embedded on my arm.

There is no feeling, it is natural.

As soon as I thought about it, a blue page popped up.

Regional chat interface, national chat interface (black), transaction interface, friend interface (black), mall!

Qin Long soon figured out the function of this bracelet.

It turns out that all the humans on Blue Star have been fucked here.

The bracelet allows humans to chat and trade with each other.

National Chat is now black and has not been started!

All mankind should be divided into many areas.

The number of people in the area shows 10,000!

There should be 10,000 people in one area!

In the trading interface, everyone can trade with each other.

Trade what each other needs!

As for this mall, if you click on it, you will see that it currently only has some simple food, drinks and tools!

But this currency is really intriguing!

If you want to buy something in this mall, you have to use your own longevity to buy it!

A bucket of five kilograms of pure water requires one year of life!

An iron ax or other tool requires ten years of life!

This is a bit too much.

Use your longevity to exchange for these things.

This is simply unimaginable.

Five pounds of water requires one year of life.

If there is no water to be found outside, there is nothing to trade.

Doesn't that mean you have to use your own longevity to drink water?

How long does a normal human being have in total?

According to the things exchanged in this mall.

For ordinary middle-aged people, as long as they change a few tools, it will be basically straightforward!

And you still can’t see how much longevity you have!

Because there is a longevity monitor in the mall, and it takes ten years of longevity to replace it.

With the longevity monitor, you can see how much longevity you have left.

This is just a bit of a gamble!
